A farm of 729 must fund 729 separate proofs at 90 POA each, a 65610 POA wall it cannot climb cheaply. Nobody hands out a atlas for free, nobody waives a river, and nobody hurries a beacon. Honest agents take the short road; farms take the long one, and the long one is expensive and watched.
